_comment: "Amp 3. You may destroy a LIGHTNING FLOW you control. IF YOU DO, this gets go again." It was MAY_DESTROY_SILVERS_TO_EQUIP -- a bespoke effect for Blacktek Whisperers' graveyard static ("destroy N Silvers you control, then EQUIP this from the graveyard"), which reads neither the 'target' naming what to destroy nor the 'effects_if_destroyed' holding the payoff. So this card destroyed Silvers if it had any, tried to equip an Action card, and never granted go again. DESTROY_PERMANENT names the token by asset and records what it destroyed, which is what "if you do" reads.
